doc.name: B — editorial frames, mountain hut firelight (fog), graphic hard-shadow minimalism

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: mountain hut firelight (fog)
Register: graphic hard-shadow minimalism
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a back-of-head frame of the female lead facing away into the scene, featuring the female lead from behind.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 90mm tilt-shift at f/2.8, using deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. Split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/1.8, using diagonal dynamic balance across the frame, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a tight profile frame with the second lead soft in the background, featuring one lead sharp, one soft.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/16, using frame-within-frame using foreground architecture, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. An overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a candid in-between moment, neither lead aware of the camera, featuring both leads mid-gesture.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 105mm macro at f/16, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a top-down flat frame.

LIGHT. Scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a mountain hut firelight (fog), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 14mm ultra-wide at f/2, using a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge, at an extreme close-up.

LIGHT. A projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
